verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own marketing says it automatically extracts action items into notes after every meeting, so the core extraction capability is documented. Nothing in the evidence shows those items are assigned to owners or gathered into a dedicated, trackable list or tracker. The AskFred "my action items" prompt is only an example question, not documented support. Missing for 10: owner attribution on action items, a centralized place to collect and track action items across meetings, in-depth docs on action-item extraction, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, action items with owners are automatically extracted from the conversation and collected somewhere I can track them

citations.quote: Get detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries instantly after every meeting.
Fred records, transcribes, & summarizes meetings with notes, decisions, & action items.
